rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when one event happens earlier than another.

example.english: The film release is scheduled to precede the concert.
example.traditional: 套戲上映早過場演唱會。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 soeng5 jing2 zou2 gwo3 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2

rows.traditional: A 行喺 B 前面
rows.jyutping: A haang4 hai2 B cin4 min6
rows.note: Use this for physically going or walking in front of someone or something.

example.english: I’ll precede you through the crowd, so follow me.
example.traditional: 我行喺你前面，你跟住我啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 hai2 nei5 cin4 min6 nei5 gan1 zyu6 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when one person or thing has higher rank or status than another.

example.english: The manager does precede me in the company hierarchy, so of course I follow his instructions.
example.traditional: 經理高過我，我梗係要聽佢話啦。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 gou1 gwo3 ngo5 ngo5 gang2 hai6 jiu3 ting1 keoi5 waa6 laa1
